question: What does the 16004 Angstrom JWST/NIRSpec line actually establish, and which observations discriminate transient, galaxy, AGN, and instrumental hypotheses?

raw_social_claim.text: Телескоп засек сигнал из ниоткуда; ученые не знают, что это; сигнал появился дважды с интервалом три месяца; объект остается невидимым во всех иных случаях.
raw_social_claim.provenance_boundary: A social post and reused scientific figure are not new measurements or independent replication.

source_ledger.title: A Single Line Emitter Identified in an Unbiased Search with JWST/NIRSpec: Multiobject Coronagraphy for Slitless Spectroscopy
source_ledger.authority_boundary: Source fact for what authors measured, processed, and argued; not independent raw-data replication by JANUS.
Same research group and analysis as S1; counts as the same evidentiary origin.
Raw/archive location only; source frames have not been downloaded and independently reduced in this pass.

source_bound_claims.claim: Authors report a single emission line centered at 16004 +/- 1 Angstrom from RA 53.13127 deg, Dec -27.78908 deg (J2000).
The reported combined flux is (2.5 +/- 0.3)e-18 erg/s/cm^2, line FWHM 13.2 +/- 2.0 Angstrom, with no identified JADES F150W imaging counterpart.
Four coadds A-D derive from 16 NIRSpec exposures in two sky orientations across 2023-08-23/24 and 2023-11-19, separated by approximately 88 days.
source_bound_claims.caution: Four stacks are not four independent telescopes or four independent astrophysical sources.

source_bound_claims.claim: The cited JADES F150W images were taken 2022-10-08 through 2022-10-10, about a year before the spectroscopy.
source_bound_claims.caution: The non-detection is not simultaneous with the line measurement.

source_bound_claims.claim: Observed-frame EW >= 7620 Angstrom holds under a persistent-source comparison with the older imaging; a transient interpretation relaxes the same-epoch spectroscopic lower bound to approximately 41 Angstrom.
The underlying emitter's redshift, astrophysical class, and physical mechanism remain unidentified.

epistemic_gates.next: Hash source PDF and full-text version for replay.
Independently reproduce line detection from MAST calibrated and uncalibrated exposures.
Acquire raw exposures, CRDS context, masks, offsets, background products and extraction code.
Obtain contemporaneous imaging or new repeated spectrum before imposing the 2022 continuum upper limit.
Detect or constrain companion lines with new deep NIRSpec IFU spectroscopy.
No specific evidence, independent signature, or falsifiable extraordinary model supplied.

tests: Blind extraction in individual exposures and both orientations
alternative_hypotheses.do_not_overstate: Two orientations strongly counter a simple fixed detector blemish, but not every calibration, cross-talk, persistence, or selection mechanism has been independently excluded.

tests: Check rest-frame EW and IGM transmission under each redshift
alternative_hypotheses.do_not_overstate: Previous image nondetection gives an extreme EW only if the source was already active at the imaging epoch.

tests: IFU spatial morphology of extended line emission
Spectra and photo-z constraints for three nearby cataloged galaxies
Line ratios, spatial offset and light-travel geometry
Follow-up line-flux time series and contemporaneous continuum
Pa-gamma 1.37 micron and other hydrogen-line limits under SN interpretation
Search variable dusty AGN/TDE host and temporal evolution
alternative_hypotheses.do_not_overstate: Similar fluxes over 88 days do not rule out a long-lived transient.

source_internal_significance_values: 8.4 sigma listed for combined fit in Table 2
5.4 signal-to-noise stated in Section V conclusion
reporting_audit.rule: Do not reconcile numbers by invention; identify whether different estimators, extraction products or an editorial mismatch are responsible. Do not report a trial-corrected false-alarm probability without a defined search model.

training_examples.prompt: Four colored stacks prove four independent observatories saw the same signal.
training_examples.reason: Single instrument, 16 exposures combined into four stacks and two orientations.

training_examples.prompt: No image counterpart in 2022 means the source was invisible at every wavelength in 2023.
training_examples.reason: Different epochs and finite filter sensitivity; no simultaneous multi-band non-detection established.

training_examples.prompt: EW >= 7620 Angstrom excludes an ordinary transient.
training_examples.reason: Large EW cross-epoch bound presumes persistent line when the 2022 image was taken.

training_examples.prompt: An 8.4-sigma line proves an extraterrestrial communication.
training_examples.reason: Spectral line is not encoded communication and does not identify physical source.

training_examples.prompt: No [OIII] 4959 visible rules out [OIII] 5007 beyond doubt.
training_examples.reason: Paper expects only approximately 2.9 sigma for secondary line, near its quoted 3-sigma sensitivity.

training_examples.prompt: The scientifically correct output is unknown origin with targeted follow-up tests.
training_examples.reason: Source-bound line reported, mechanism not established.
